Business Consulting · B

Sales & Revenue Optimisation

Revenue depends on structures as much as on effort. We review how your sales work today, from acquisition to quotation to account development, and build a clearer, more efficient sales process.

Request a consultation

What we do

Objective

Build transparent and efficient sales structures that support sustainable revenue development.

  • Review of existing sales structures
  • Optimisation of sales processes
  • Development of sales strategies
  • Customer acquisition
  • Customer retention and account development
  • Analysis of revenue and sales performance indicators
  • Identification of additional revenue opportunities
  • Optimisation of quotation and sales structures

Typical starting points

  1. 01How does an enquiry become a quotation, and a quotation an order?
  2. 02Which customers and services contribute most to revenue?
  3. 03Which indicators do you use to steer sales today?

Other consulting areas

All business consulting services
  • APeople & Organisational OptimisationAlign people, tasks and responsibilities in an effective and practical way.
  • CDocument & Process OptimisationReduce unnecessary administrative effort, improve transparency and establish clear workflows.
  • DOperational & Cost OptimisationHelp businesses use their financial and operational resources more consciously and efficiently.
  • EBusiness Development & Strategic ConsultingEstablish a clear business direction and a sustainable foundation for future development.

Would you like to improve your operational workflows, optimise your sales structures, prepare a property decision or unlock new business opportunities? We look forward to learning about your situation.
